name: chat-composer
title: ChatComposer
description: Chat input with autosizing text, validated attachments, a model picker, tools, a counter and streaming Stop. Optional submitMode="mod+enter" lets Enter add a line and Ctrl/Meta+Enter send; the default remains Enter to send. Both modes ignore IME composition. header renders above attachments (use ChatComposerHeader with title, optional onClose and children); prefix sits at the inline start of the text row, following LTR/RTL direction; footer sits below the toolbar and above the hint. readOnly keeps text focusable and selectable without dimming, disables sending and hides attachment editing; Stop still works. actionsRef exposes focus(start/end/all), insert(text, cursor/start/end), clear() and getValue(); the normal ref still points to the textarea. insert replaces the selection and restores the caret after rendering: controlled parents must apply onValueChange synchronously (debounced updates can lose the caret). clear removes text only, keeping attachments. With none of the new props set, the DOM and keyboard behavior are unchanged. Examples show quote reply with a header and one chip, text actions, multiline submission and read-only drafts.
author: gntik-ai

export type ChatMessageKey = keyof typeof FALLBACK;

/** `useI18n()` plus `tc()`, a translator for the newer chat keys with English fallbacks. */
export function useChatI18n() {
  const i18n = useI18n();
  const tc = (key: ChatMessageKey, vars?: MessageVars) => {
    const out = i18n.t(key as MessageKey, vars);
    return out === key ? interpolate(FALLBACK[key], vars, i18n.locale) : out;
  };
  return { ...i18n, tc };
}
